For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy … For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife? –1 Corinthians 7:14-16.

As we gaze across the thoroughfare of homes surrounding us, we grieve as we behold one Christian tragedy after another. Almost every Christian has some near kin who has experienced divorce, a rebellious child, or strained marital relationships. Perhaps we cry out to God as we wonder why it is so, for it is surely not His plan. Herein we behold the apostle Paul bringing out an amazing principle that is little understood and even less employed—a sanctified home. It is what every sincere believer wants and seeks, but few apprehend. Christianity is not a rubber stamp that automatically clones offspring after the same sort. Still the scripture must be true and there must indeed be a sanctifying effect that a true believer brings into a home. This is no guarantee that the unbelieving spouse or the children of the union will be saved, but when a believing husband or wife acts in accordance with the scripture and the Spirit of God, the effect they have on the home will allow God’s power to be evident and an avenue of grace is poured into the pathway of all who dwell therein.

Our impotency is not caused due to the lack of God’s power, but because our dim understanding is infested and infiltrated with the influences of this present world. Faith in God alone is inevitably a powerful force, while faith injected by human reasoning and impatience will hardly prove any more effective than Abraham and Hagar’s attempts to produce a holy and sanctified child.

What then sanctifies the home? Casual observation will notice that merely being a believer isn’t enough to accomplish it. To sanctify is to make pure and holy. It is a process of filtering and a separation from that which is impure to bring greater purity to the object being sanctified. The Pharisees understood the principle well. They spent many a rigorous hour paying heed to countless miniscule details to make their vessels holy. Still, they were critically unsuccessful.

Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess. Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also –Matthew 23:25-26.

The Inside Sanctified by Faith and Prayer

What a foolish thing it would be for a man to wash only the outside of a cup, which is to be looked at, and to leave the inside dirty, which is to be used. Yet there are those who avoid only the scandalous sins—those that would spoil their reputation with men—but would still allow themselves pride and moral decay in their heart. It is this which renders them odious to the pure and holy God. Such it is when a man or woman seeks to purify their home by superficial cleansing. Pharisaic attempts to root out and remove the surface details and inconsistencies from the lives of their helpmate and children, in order to sanctify them, are generally fruitless.

However quick-sighted they are in other things; Christ calls them blind. In Christ’s estimation, those who are not acquainted with the wickedness of their own hearts—those who see not, and hate not, the secret sin that is lodged within—are strangers to sanctification. Self-ignorance is the most shameful and hurtful ignorance. The rule is, “Cleanse first that which is within, to get cleansed from the filthiness of the spirit.” Corrupt affections and inclinations, the secret lusts that lurk in the soul, unseen and unobserved, these must first be recognized, mortified, and subdued. If due care is taken concerning that, the outside will, by extension, become clean also. External motives and inducements may keep the outside clean, while the inside remains filthy; but if renewed sanctifying grace makes the inside clean, that will have a lasting and profound influence upon the outside, for the commanding principle is within. If the heart is well kept, all is well, …for out of it are the issues of life –Proverbs 4:23.

Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives; While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear. Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement. Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered –1 Peter 3:1-7.

Here Peter speaks of a wife winning her husband with the due benevolence mentioned in Corinthians. While she has no unconditional guarantee of sanctifying her husband, she certainly will meet with little success without it. Eunice was a Jewess, who, upon embracing faith in Christ, found herself in an unequal yoke with a Greek. We read that unfeigned faith was first wrought in her mother Lois, and that affected Eunice. This, in turn, had a sanctifying effect on young Timothy, who was then prepared for the work of the Lord. We have no record that his father was added to the faith, but one can only imagine the initial turmoil within the breast of this young Jewess as she reverently honored her head and circumcised not her son but rather committed him to prayer. Here brings us to the other vital dimension of home sanctification. While she was not emboldened to teach her husband, she apparently had won his respect enough to allow her to teach her son in the home. This she diligently did… For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer –1 Timothy 4:5.

And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus. All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness –2 Timothy 3:15-16.

The Outside Sanctified by the Word

When the heart of the believer is dealt with first, the visible dimensions of the home fall into place in succession. Worldly influences have little appeal for the budding child of God. The Word of God must take its full place being administered to the children as well as the adults, for they are profitable for sanctification. A husband is to wash his wife and children (as well as himself) by administering the Word of God so that he may sanctify and cleanse his home.

Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish –Ephesians 5:25-27.

When the Word of God is given full authority in the home, it becomes the governing principle around which the home operates. It must be allowed to filter out the media of the masses and the influences of all evil communications, which will corrupt good manners.

Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful –Psalm 1:1.

Individuals within the home may not always appreciate the direction received from it, but submit to it they must, and usually do so heartily. Most of us have received direction from our parents that we did not appreciate at the time but years later have come to grasp the blessedness of their leadership. Leadership that does not lead, is not expressing love, and will leave the home unsanctified and its members disconnected. Though it is rather uncomfortable and inconvenient to ask children to do without what others are partaking in, they are not sanctified by following their peers, but rather by the truth. For us as parents, there is no greater joy than to know that our children walk in truth. Equally so, there is no greater joy for them than to walk in it. Daily family devotions are a cohesive force within the home that is central and integral to home sanctification. We dare not apologize for the authority we give to the Word, nor slack from its use. It is an erroneous Gospel to believe that souls are stifled who are held to the mandates within it.

Here is Christ’s summation of His home.

I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word. Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee. For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me. I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine. And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them. And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are. While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled. And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves. I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil. They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth –John 17:6-17.

Christ, as the head of His home, employed no complicated means to the sanctification of His children. His life manifested a constant keeping Himself in the love of God through faith and prayer, and the administration of God’s Word to those about Him. At times they stumbled at it, wrestled inwardly, and misunderstood Him, but the keeping force rested not on the laurels of convincing words, adamant force, fun activities, nor prudent reasoning.

While a home must employ these resources from time to time, they of themselves do not carry the sanctifying power. For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer –1 Timothy 4:5.

Kwa maana mume asiyeamini anasagirishwa kwa mke, na mke asiyeamini anasagirishwa kwa mume: vinginevyo watoto wenu wangekuwa wasafi; lakini sasa wao wamesemwa watakatifu … Kwa maana wewe mke, ni nini unasikiwazi, ikiwa utamwokoa mume wako? au wewe mwanamume, ni vipi unasikiwazi, ikiwa utamwokoa mke wako? –1 Wakorintho 7:14-16.

Tunapoangalia makazi yaliyo karibu nasi, tunalia tukiona taabu ya Wakristo mmoja baada ya mwingine. Karibu kila Mkristo ana ndugu wa karibu ambaye amepitia talaka, mtoto mkaidi, au uhusiano wa ndoa uliokandamizwa. Labda tunamwomba Mungu tukijiuliza kwa nini ni hivyo, kwa kuwa hakiwezi kuwa mpango Wake. Hapa tunaona mtume Paulo akitoa kanuni ya ajabu ambayo haieleweki vya kutosha na haitekelezeki mara nyingi—nyumba iliyo takatifu. Hii ndicho kila mja wa kweli anachotaka na kutafuta, lakini wachache wanaielewa. Ukristo si muhuri unaokariri watoto kwa mtindo uleule. Hata hivyo maandiko lazima yawe ya kweli na hakika kuwepo kwa athari ya kutakasisha ambayo mja wa kweli huleta katika nyumba. Hii si dhamana kwamba mke asiyeamini au watoto wa ndoa wataokolewa, lakini mume au mke mwenye imani anapofanya kwa mujibu wa maandiko na Roho wa Mungu, athari yao kwa nyumba itaruhusu nguvu za Mungu kuwa dhahiri na njia ya neema itamwagwa katika njia ya wote wanaoishi humo.

Udhaifu wetu hautokana na upungufu wa nguvu za Mungu, bali kutokana na ufahamu wetu hafifu ambao umejazwa na kuingiliwa na yale yanayoathiri dunia ya sasa. Imani kwa Mungu peke yake ni nguvu isiyoweza kuzuilika, wakati imani iliyochanganywa na hoja za kibinadamu na uvumilivu mdogo haitakuwa na ufanisi zaidi kuliko matamanio ya Abrahamu na Hagar kuyajenga mtoto mtakatifu na mtakasishi.

Basi ni nini kinachotakasisha nyumba? Uchunguzi wa kawaida utaona kuwa kuwa mja peke yake si vya kutosha kuifikisha. Kutakatisha ni kuifanya safi na mtakatifu. Ni mchakato wa kuchuja na kutenganisha kutoka kwa kile kisicho safi ili kuleta usafi zaidi kwa kile kinachotakatishwa. Wafirisi waliielewa vizuri kanuni hii. Walitumia masaa mengi kwa bidii kuzingatia maelezo madogo madogo ili kutengeneza vyombo vyao vitakatifu. Hata hivyo, walishindwa kwa kiasi kikubwa.

Je, ninyi mnaomboleza, waandishi wa sheria na Wafirisi, wenye unafiki! kwa maana mnafanya safi upande wa nje wa kikombe na sahani, bali ndani yake zimejaa wizi na unyonyaji wa kupindukia. Wewe Mfarisi mwepesi wa macho, safisha kwanza yale yaliyo ndani ya kikombe na sahani, ili punde pia vyavyo nje vyawe safi –Mathayo 23:25-26.

Ndani Inayotakatishwa kwa Imani na Maombi

Ni jambo la upumbavu kwa mtu kuosha tu upande wa nje wa kikombe, ambacho kinatazamwa, na kuiacha ndani uchafu, ambacho kinatumika. Hata hivyo wapo waliokwepa dhambi za aibu tu—zisizopendeza kwa watu—lakini bado wanajiruhusu kiburi na kuharibika kwa moyo. Hili ndilo linawaleta wadhambi kwa Mungu mtakatifu na safi. Hivyo ndivyo mtu au mwanamke anapojaribu kusafisha nyumba yao kwa usafi wa nje tu. Juhudi za kifarisi za kuondoa na kuondoa maelezo ya uso na kutokubaliana kwa maisha ya mpenzi wao na watoto, ili kuwatakatisha, mara nyingi hazina tija.

Hata wakimwona vyema mambo mengine; Kristo anawaita vipofu. Kwa mtazamo wa Kristo, wale wasiofahamu ujeuri wa mioyo yao wenyewe—wale wasioona, na wasiotaka, dhambi za siri zilizomo ndani yao—ni wageni kwa utakatifu. Kutojijua ni ujinga wenye aibu na uharibifu zaidi. Kanuni ni, “Safisha kwanza yale yaliyo ndani, ili upate kusafiwa kutokana na uchafu wa roho.” Hisia na mwelekeo uovu, tamaa za siri zinazofichika kwa nafsi, zisizoonekana na zisizoonyeshwa, hizi lazima kwanza zitambuliwe, zifufuliwe, na zitawaliwe. Ikitiliwa maanani kwa uangalifu huo, upande wa nje pia utakuwa safi kwa nyongeza. Motisha za nje na vishawishi vinaweza kuifanya upande wa nje uwaze safi, wakati ndani bado uchafu; lakini ikiwa neema mpya ya kutakatisha inafanya ndani kuwa safi, hilo litakuwa na athari ya kudumu na ya kina juu ya upande wa nje, kwa kuwa kanuni inayotawala iko ndani. Ikiwa moyo umehifadhiwa vyema, kila kitu kiko sawa, …kwa kuwa kutoka ndani yake hutiririka mambo ya uzima –Methali 4:23.

Vivyo hivyo, ninyi wake, muwe chini ya wake zenu; kwamba, ikiwa kunaaye asikiliza neno, nao pia bila neno wapewe kwa mazungumzo ya wake; Wakati wakiwaona mkewe habashisi pamoja na woga. Ashrafu yao hawezi kuwa urembo wa nje wa kufumua nywele, na kuvaa dhahabu, au kuvaa nguo; Bali afadhali awe mtu wa moyo uliofichika, katika kile kisichoweza kuoza, hata mapambo ya roho ya unyenyekevu na utulivu, ambayo mbele za Mungu ni ya thamani kubwa. Kwa hivyo katika nyakati za zamani wake watakatifu pia, waliomwaminifu Mungu, walijipamba wake kwa kuwa chini ya wake zao: Kama Sara alimsikiliza Abrahamu, akimwita bwana: kwamba ninyi ni binti zake, msipojuwa mabaya, na msikubhuni kwa hofu yoyote. Vivyo hivyo ninyi wake, baki nao kwa uelewa, mkimpa heshima mke, kama kwa chombo dhaifu, na kama warithi pamoja wa neema ya uzima; ili sala zenu zisizuilike –1 Petro 3:1-7.

Hapa Petro anazungumzia mke kumshawishi mume wake kwa wema unaotajwa katika Wakorintho. Ingawa hana dhamana isiyokuwa ya masharti ya kumtakatisha mume wake, hakika hatapata mafanikio makubwa bila yake. Eunisi alikuwa Muyahudi, ambaye alipokuja kumwamini Kristo, alijikuta mbele ya panga lisilolingana na Mgiriki. Tunasoma kwamba imani ya kweli ilianzishwa kwanza kwa mama yake Loisi, na hiyo ilimgusa Eunisi. Hii, kwa upande mwingine, iliwaathiri Watimeo mdogo, ambaye kisha alitayarishwa kwa kazi ya Bwana. Hatuna rekodi kwamba baba yake aliongezwa katika imani, lakini mtu anaweza tu kufikiria vurugu za mwanzo katika moyo wa huyu mwanamke Muyahudi alipomheshimu mume wake kwa adabu na akamfikia sio kumkalia mtoto wake bali kumtegemea kwa sala. Hapa tunaelekezwa kwa kipengele kingine muhimu cha kutakatisha nyumba. Wakati hakuwa na ujasiri wa kumfundisha mume wake, alionekana kumshinda kwa heshima vya kutosha kumruhusu kumfundisha mtoto wake nyumbani. Hili alilifanya kwa bidii… Kwa maana imetakatishwa kwa neno la Mungu na sala –1 Timotheo 4:5.

Na tangu utotoni umejua maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukufanya mwenye busara kwa wokovu kwa kupitia imani iliyo ndani ya Kristo Yesu. Maandishi yote yametolewa kwa kuongozwa na Mungu, na ni ya manufaa kwa mafundisho, kwa kukosoa, kwa marekebisho, kwa mafundisho katika haki –2 Timotheo 3:15-16.

Nje Inayotakatishwa kwa Neno

Wakati moyo wa mja umepewa kipaumbele kwanza, vipimo vinavyoonekana vya nyumba vinafuata kwa mpangilio. Mwitikio wa dunia hakuna mvuto mkubwa kwa mtoto aliyekua katika Mungu. Neno la Mungu lazima lishikwe kwa nafasi yake kamili likitolewa kwa watoto pamoja na watu wazima, kwa kuwa ni manufaa kwa utakatishaji. Mume anapaswa kuosha mke wake na watoto (pamoja na yeye mwenyewe) kwa kutekeleza Neno la Mungu ili aweze kuwatakatisha na kuwafanya wasafi nyumba yake.

Wame, wapendeni wake zenu, kama vile Kristo pia alivyompenda kanisa, nawe akajitoa kwa ajili yake; Ili atakayetatakisha na kuyasafisha kwa kufua kwa maji kwa neno, Ili ampresente yeye mbele yake kanisa lenye utukufu, lisilo na doa, wala wembe, wala kitu kama hicho; bali ili liwe watakatifu na lisilo na hitilafu –Waefeso 5:25-27.

Wakati Neno la Mungu linapopewa mamlaka kamili katika nyumba, linakuwa kanuni inayotawala ambayo nyumba inaendesha karibu nayo. Lazima liruhusiwe kuchuja vyombo vya habari vya umma na athari za mawasiliano mabaya yote, ambayo yatakavyosha maadili mema.

Barikiwa mtu asiyekwenda katika shauri la wasio wa Mungu, wala kusimama katika njia za wanafiki, wala kukaa kwenye kiti cha wachokozi –Zaburi 1:1.

Watu ndani ya nyumba hawaziwezi kila wakati kuthamini maelekezo yanayotokana nayo, lakini lazima wakubali, na kwa kawaida hufanya hivyo kwa moyo wote. Wengi wetu tumepokea maelekezo kutoka kwa wazazi wetu ambayo hatukuithamini wakati huo lakini miaka baadaye tumekuja kuelewa baraka za uongozi wao. Uongozi usioongoza, hauonyeshi upendo, na utaiacha nyumba isiyotakatishwa na wanachama wake wakiwa wamegawanyika. Ingawa ni jambo lisilotabasamu na lisilofaa kuwataka watoto wajiachilie kile ambacho wengine wanakishiriki, hawatafanywa watakatifu kwa kufuata wenzao, bali kwa kweli. Kwa sisi wazazi, hakuna furaha kubwa zaidi kuliko kujua watoto wetu wanatembea katika kweli. Vivyo hivyo, hakuna furaha kubwa kwao kuliko kutembea katika kweli. Ibada za familia za kila siku ni nguvu inayoshikilia ndani ya nyumba ambayo ni katikati na ni sehemu ya utakatishaji wa nyumba. Hatuwezi kusikitishwa kwa mamlaka tunayompa Neno, wala kusita kuutilia uzito. Ni Injili isiyo sahihi kuamini kwamba roho zinazimika pale zinaposhikiliwa kwa maagizo yake.

Hapa ni muhtasari wa Kristo kuhusu nyumba Yake.

Nimeonyesha jina lako kwa watu uliyonipa kutoka duniani: wao walikuwa wako, naye ukawanipa mimi; nao wamehifadhi neno lako. Sasa wamejua kuwa vitu vyote ulinipa mimi ni kutoka kwako. Maana nimewapa maneno uliyoniagiza; nao wameyakubali, na wamejua kwa hakika kuwa nimetoka kwako, na wameamini kuwa ulikinituma. Naamini kwa ajili yao: si kwa ajili ya ulimwengu ninaleta maombi, bali kwa wale uliyonipa; kwa maana wao ni wako. Na wote wangu ni wako, na wako wangu; nami nimeshuhuriwa kwao. Na sasa mimi sipo tena ulimwenguni, lakini hawa wapo ulimwenguni, nami ninakuja kwako. Baba mtakatifu, uwahifadhi kwa jina lako wale uliyonipa, ili wawe wamoja, kama sisi sisi. Nilipokuwa pamoja nao ulimwenguni, mimi niliwahifadhi kwa jina lako: wale uliyonipa mimi niliwahifadhi, wala hakuna mmoja wao aliyepotea, isipokuwa mwana wa upotevu; ili maandiko yatekelezwe. Na sasa ninakuja kwako; na mambo haya naliyoongea ulimwenguni, ili furaha yangu iwafikie nao imekamilishwa ndani yao. Nimewapa neno lako; na ulimwengu umewachukia, kwa sababu sio wa ulimwengu, kama mimi si wa ulimwengu. Siwezi kuomba uwatakeeze kutoka ulimwenguni, bali uwahifadhi na yule mwovu. Si wao wa ulimwengu, kama mimi si wa ulimwengu. Watakasishwe kwa kweli yako: neno lako ni kweli –Yohana 17:6-17.

Kristo, kama kichwa cha Nyumba Yake, hakutumia njia tata za kutakatisha watoto wake. Maisha Yake yalionyesha kuhifadhi kwa wakati wote Mwenyewe katika upendo wa Mungu kupitia imani na maombi, na utoaji wa Neno la Mungu kwa waliomzunguka. Wakati mwingine walinigomea, wakipingana ndani, na wakamkosea, lakini nguvu ya kuwatunza haikuegemea maneno yenye kumshawishi, nguvu kali, shughuli za kufurahisha, wala hoja tata za busara.

Wakati nyumba inapaswa kutumia vyanzo hivi mara kwa mara, wenyewe havina nguvu ya kutakatisha. Kwa maana imetakatishwa kwa neno la Mungu na sala –1 Timotheo 4:5.

As we discussed in the first part of this two-part series, cancer is not a single entity. Various cancers have general similarities in that they develop from normal cells which mutate to make them grow in an uncontrolled, unnatural fashion, yet each type of cancer behaves in its specific, unique way.

Some cancers are aggressive, and some are much slower growing. Some tend to be localized and are quite slow to spread to other parts of the body, whereas others are likely to show up in locations far from where they began.

It is not possible to make blanket statements about cancers, but in this section, I will discuss some general things about prevention and treatment, then I’ll finish with some thoughts about us as Christians relating to someone who is dealing with cancer.

Lifestyle Changes to Prevent Cancers

Many of the things that increase the risk of cancer are things that (hopefully) we, as Christian people, are already avoiding.

Tobacco is one such thing. Tobacco, when smoked, increases the risk of lung cancer. It also increases the risk of head cancer, neck cancers, esophageal cancer, stomach cancer, and cancers of the liver and bladder.

Alcohol is another substance that raises the risk of cancer. Liver, voice box, and esophagus cancers are all related to alcohol consumption. Some people claim to drink alcohol for “health benefits,” but there is no safe level of alcohol consumption. Even people who drink moderately have an increased risk of death related to their alcohol usage.i

Another thing that should be limited is exposure to ultraviolet radiation. We know that UV radiation increases the risk of skin cancers, so wearing clothing that protects, such as hats and long-sleeved garments, and using sunblock can reduce this risk.

On the positive side of things, healthy eating habits, such as consuming lots of fruits and vegetables and avoiding highly processed foods, will reduce the risk of colon cancer.ii Fiber seems to be a key here and higher levels of dietary fiber are helpful. Additionally, fruits and vegetables are rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals and are supportive of a healthy immune system. It is recommended to eat at least two servings of fruit and five servings of vegetables per day.

It is interesting that while people who eat healthy diets have a decreased risk of cancer, there is little evidence that there are specific vitamins that will prevent cancer. That is, there is little benefit if you eat a very unhealthy diet and then take vitamins in an effort to compensate for your unwise choices.

Prior to doing a controlled test it is always hard to know whether or not a certain supplement will help. Vitamin E is an antioxidant and so it was thought to be helpful in the prevention of cancer. However, it turns out that studies have not shown this to be true. Actually, in high doses, it seems to increase the risk of certain cancers and heart disease.iii

Rather than trying to find the right supplements, it is more important to make certain that we are eating healthy diets.

Chemotherapy

Now, let us move to a brief discussion about different types of treatment for cancer. Chemotherapy is probably what most people think of first. It was first used in the 1940s when doctors used a derivative of nitrogen mustard to treat lymphoma.

Since that time, hundreds of different medications have been developed as chemotherapy, designed to attack the cancer cells. It is hard to generalize about chemotherapy because there are so many different medications designed to treat different cancers and because they have different side effects.

Due to the fact that they attack cells that are rapidly multiplying, many of these drugs tend to make a person’s hair fall out since hair cells are of the rapidly multiplying type. Nausea, vomiting, and blood count alterations (low white cell counts) are other common side effects.

If a cancer has spread from its initial location, chances are good that it will require more than just one type of medication in order to achieve remission.

Even if a cancer hasn’t spread, surgeons will often recommend doing some chemotherapy ahead of surgery to shrink the tumor and to make surgical removal easier.

While chemotherapy sounds scary, it actually works quite well for certain types of cancers, such as blood cancers (like leukemias), lymphoma, and breast cancer.

These days, cancer doctors test the biopsied cancer cells for genetic markers. As a family doctor, I see these reports but, since I am not a specialist in this field, I find them somewhat confusing. The important thing to remember is that these markers help to predict what the best drugs are to use on a specific type of cancer.

Surgery

For many years, surgery was the cornerstone of cancer treatment. Cancers that have not spread can be removed entirely, allowing a person to move forward without any further treatment.

Often, by the time that a person’s cancer is discovered, it is too late to completely remove it. Surgery can still be helpful. For one thing, it gives a sample of the cancer for testing to help identify the best treatment. More than that, even if a cancer has spread, there are times that a tumor needs to be removed, simply because of the organs that it is putting pressure on.

I have heard some people claim that it is dangerous for a cancer to be exposed to oxygen. They believe that cancer cells spread faster after the tissues are opened up and exposed to the air during surgery. There is no documented evidence to support this idea. Many people do seem to get sicker after having an exploratory surgery when their cancer is being diagnosed. But the issue isn’t really the air getting into the cancer cells, rather the cancer was most certainly at the point of beginning to exhibit serious symptoms, and the surgery simply brought things to a head. Also, any surgery will be stressful for any person’s body, which will only increase the wearing down of a person’s already taxed strength and vitality—their ability to stay on top of a debilitating illness.

Typically, when a tumor is removed, nearby lymph glands will be sampled to see if they contain cancer cells. This presence, or absence, of cells helps with the “staging” of the cancer (such as “stage 3” or “stage 4”) and will provide insight for further treatment to prevent a chance of recurrence.

Immunotherapy

One of the newest treatments of cancer is called immunotherapy. These are medications that rev up a patient’s immune system to clear their body of cancer cells.

This sounds great and you would think the side effects should be minimal. Unfortunately, it doesn’t always work according to plan. Some cancers don’t respond to these sorts of treatments. And as far as side effects go, these medications can result in autoimmune diseases. When a medication is prescribed that makes the immune system extra active (or over-active), sometimes it begins to attack the patient’s own organs. While some of these side effects get better with the cessation of treatment, not all of them go away.

As an example, I had a patient who took immunotherapy for melanoma that had spread to his lymph glands. He was cured of the cancer, but the immunotherapy damaged his saliva glands enough that he has ongoing issues with a dry mouth. At this point, it seems unlikely that he will regain that moisture in his mouth.

Future Treatments

There will probably be more treatments in the future, targeting specific types of cancers. Something that is currently under investigation are vaccines that would target specific types of cancers. Currently none of these are available except in clinical trials.

Choosing Wisely

Oncologists (cancer specialists) do not know the future. They talk in terms of percentages. One protocol has an 86 percent chance of achieving a two-year remission from cancer, another only 56 percent. The same thing is true for side effects. While a doctor can tell you that 26 percent of patients get nauseated with a treatment, that doesn’t tell you if you will be one of that 26 percent and whether that nausea will be controllable with anti-nausea medication.

In deciding what course of treatment to choose, you will find no Bible passage to indicate one direction or another. Having a good oncologist who will explain things carefully—both the chance of success and risk of side effects—is key. There are times that you may need to change to a different cancer doctor, simply because the one you have does not take the time that you need to feel comfortable with your treatment.

If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him –James 1:5. We need wisdom in many areas of our lives, but certainly choosing how to navigate medical decisions is one of those areas. It is a wonderful thing that God has promised to give us the wisdom that we need—if we just ask.

Prayer—both personal prayer and by your church community—is very important. Prayers can be for healing. It can also be for caring, Christian, medical caregivers, and for wisdom in choosing the best treatments.

Sometimes God cures through doctors and medications. Sometimes, He heals in spite of them. Sometimes He decides it is time for us to go home to be with Him, thereby providing us with a new body that is not sick and broken.

Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases –Psalm 103:2-3. With all of the medical technology available to us, it is easy to forget that healing comes from God. All the chemotherapy in the world will not avail if God does not work an act of healing. At the same time, there are many times that God works in miraculous ways to heal despite the dire predictions made by the medical professionals or other well-meaning individuals.

Often the best that a patient can do is to choose (according to their best judgment) the best treatment course (based on success rate and side effects) and then see how things go. If the side effects are too severe or the treatment doesn’t seem to be working, there is always the option to change.

Ultimately, when healing comes, regardless of how it comes, it is God that provides that healing. Let us never forget that.

Cancer Takes Energy

Relating to someone with cancer is not much different from relating to a person with any other chronic illness. There are differences though.

Both having cancer and receiving treatment for the cancer takes a lot of energy out of a person. While it is important not to ignore someone who has cancer, it is just as important to remember that they do not have endless energy supplies. A ten- or fifteen-minute visit may be all that they can handle. It is best to let them decide the length of visits that they have energy for.

Hesitate to Give Advice

Your “cousin” may have had cancer and may have gotten better after taking a particular supplement or visiting a particular clinic. Sharing that information with a person who is dealing with cancer is just one more piece of information for them to process out of a “thousand” others they may have received. It seems as though someone with cancer is often bombarded with advice and recommendations from well-meaning friends and family.

It is hard to figure out what the best thing is to do when a person is already low on energy. Sometimes, cancer patients simply have prayed that God would bless their choices and then have left the outcome in His hands.

If the cancer patient asks for your input, you can give it, but if not, it is probably best to hold off on the temptation to give unsought advice.

Listen

There is never a situation where listening isn’t beneficial. It is through listening that we allow others to unburden themselves from fears and frustrations. Listening can help the person to put their thoughts into words. More than that, we may hear ways in which we can help.

Maybe it is someone telling you the (too long) story of how their doctor missed their cancer. Or perhaps, it is them telling you about their fears regarding either their cancer or their treatments.

Pray

…The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much –James 5:16. This verse comes in the midst of James talking about anointing with oil, confession of sins, and physical healing.

We can certainly pray for, and with, someone who is dealing with cancer. Listening helps us to know how best we can pray for them. It lets us know what their particular struggle is on a given day and how we can best lift them up to the throne.

The passage in James makes it clear that healing does not come from the oil that is poured over someone, but rather from God’s work in their life. The prayer, the faith, and the obedient action is more important than the anointing oil, although all demonstrate a dependence on a God who is always faithful.

Do Small Chores

If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food, And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit? –James 2:15-16.

If it is not enough to pray for someone who is dealing with a serious illness, it is certainly not enough to tell them, “God bless you.”

Figuring out what things someone with cancer needs help with may not be easy, but often even little tasks are difficult for them. It could be that they need transportation to a chemotherapy appointment. Maybe they need help with making a meal, with childcare, or with cleaning their house. Helping in whatever ways we can makes a huge difference for those who are dealing with the fatigue and stress of cancer.

More than that, the important thing is that we make the effort to demonstrate our love to those in our church body who are suffering. Paul told the Corinthians that when …one member suffer[s], all the members suffer with it… –1 Corinthians 12:26. Whenever there is a need, the rest of the local church body has an obligation and should have a deep desire to help in whatever way they can.

Be Willing to Keep Your Distance

Chemotherapy can cause a cancer patient to have an extremely weak immune system. A normal white cell count is between 4,000 and 10,000. but during cancer treatments I have seen patient’s white cell count drop down to 200. In this scenario, if they catch any type of infection, they will be unable to fight off that infection and will end up in the hospital.

It is important to understand that someone in this condition who chooses to keep their distance is not necessarily trying to avoid fellowship. Rather, they are trying to avoid an unneeded hospital stay for what cancer doctors call a “neutropenic fever” (a febrile illness with a really low white cell count).

In these sorts of situations, phone calls or even text messages go a long way toward helping a brother or sister feel that they are not alone, even when they cannot physically be around other people.

Conclusion

I wish I could give a complete run down of every type of cancer out there and the best treatment for each one. That would be beyond my capability and further, it would be outdated within six months’ time.

What I can say is that prayer is key. Prayer for the Holy Spirit’s leading (see John 16:13), for energy for each day, for healing, and for God’s will to be done. Most of all, we need to pray that God would be glorified in and through us. (See 1 Peter 4:11) There have been so many people who were able to speak to their nurses and doctors about their Lord, even as they dealt with side effects and cancer symptoms.

It is easy to read all the instructions about giving up worrying that is found in Scripture and think that it should be easy to cast our cares on Him (see 1 Peter 5:7). However, it is much harder to put into practice. We may feel one day as though we have conquered fear and wake up the next morning with every bit as much anxiety as we ever had.

It is in this that we desperately need a church community. We are not alone, but we will feel alone unless we have brothers and sisters around us who help us as they are able and who pray for us in our valleys and rejoice with us in our times of victory.

It is only then, that we can come to the place that the Apostle Paul did when he said, For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain –Philippians 1:21. Of course, he was talking about a possible execution, but his resignation to God’s will was total. I pray that we too might reach that place, even as we deal with something as difficult as cancer.

Aina mbalimbali za kansa zinafanana kwa ujumla kwa kuwa hutokea kutoka kwa seli za kawaida ambazo hubadilika na kuzifanya zikue kwa njia isiyo ya kawaida na isiyodhibitiwa, lakini kila aina ya kansa huenda inapenda kujiendeleza kwa njia yake maalum na ya kipekee.

Kuna kansa ambazo ni kali, na kuna nyingine zinazokua kwa taratibu. Baadhi zinapendelea kukaa eneo moja na huwa polepole kuenea sehemu nyingine za mwili, wakati nyingine zina uwezekano mkubwa wa kuonekana kwenye maeneo mbali na pale zilipoanza.

Haiwezekani kutoa matamko ya jumla kuhusu kansa, lakini katika sehemu hii, nitajadili mambo ya jumla kuhusu utokomezaji na matibabu, kisha nitaisha kwa mawazo kuhusu sisi kama Wakristo tukihusiana na mtu ambaye anashughulika na kansa.

Mabadiliko ya Maisha Kuzuia Kansa

Mengi kati ya vitu vinavyoongeza hatari ya kansa ni vitu ambavyo (kwa matumaini) sisi, kama watu wa Kikristo, tayari tunaziepuka.

Tumbaku ni mojawapo ya vitu hivyo. Tumbaku, wakati unavyovutwa, huongeza hatari ya kansa ya mapafu. Pia huongeza hatari ya kansa za kichwa, shingo, koo, tumbo, na za ini na kibofu cha mkojo.

Pombe ni dutu nyingine inayoongeza hatari ya kansa. Kansa za ini, sanduku la sauti (kipafu cha sauti), na koo yote yanahusishwa na matumizi ya pombe. Watu wengine hujieleza kunywa pombe kwa ajili ya “faida za kiafya,” lakini hakuna kiwango salama cha matumizi ya pombe. Hata watu wanaonywa kwa kiasi cha wastani wana hatari iliyoongezeka ya kifo inayohusiana na matumizi yao ya pombe.i

Jambo jingine linalopaswa kupunguzwa ni kuwekwa chini ya mionzi ya ultraviolet. Tunajua kuwa mionzi ya UV huongeza hatari ya kansa ya ngozi, hivyo kuvaa nguo zinazolinda, kama vile kofia na nguo zenye mikono mirefu, pamoja na kutumia krimu ya kujikinga na jua kunaweza kupunguza hatari hii.

Katika upande mzuri wa mambo, tabia za kula kiafya, kama kutumia matunda na mboga kwa wingi na kuepuka vyakula vilivyochakatwa sana, zitapunguza hatari ya kansa ya utumbo mkubwa (colon).ii Wiani wa nyuzinyuzi (fiber) unaonekana kuwa muhimu hapa na viwango vya juu vya nyuzinyuzi vya lishe vinasaidia. Zaidi ya hayo, matunda na mboga ni tajiri kwa antioxidants, vitamini, na madini na vinasaidia mfumo wa kinga kuwa mzuri. Inashauriwa kula angalau sehemu mbili za matunda na sehemu tano za mboga kwa siku.

Inavutia kuwa wakati watu wanaokula mlo mzuri wana hatari ndogo ya kansa, kuna ushahidi mdogo kwamba kuna vitamini maalum zitakazozuia kansa. Yaani, kuna faida kidogo ikiwa utakula mlo mbaya sana kisha unywe vitamini kama jitihada ya kukosa ulivyochagua kihisia.

Kabla ya kufanya jaribio lililodhibitiwa mara zote ni vigumu kujua kama nyongeza fulani itasaidia. Vitamini E ni antioxidant na hivyo ilidhaniwa itasaidia katika kuzuia kansa. Hata hivyo, imekuwa wazi kuwa tafiti hazijaonyesha hili kuwa kweli. Kwa kweli, kwa dozi kubwa, inaonekana kuongeza hatari ya aina fulani za kansa na magonjwa ya moyo.iii

Badala ya kujaribu kutafuta nyongeza sahihi, ni muhimu zaidi kuhakikisha kwamba tunakula milo yenye afya.

Chemotherapia

Sasa, tuende kwenye mjadala mfupi kuhusu aina tofauti za matibabu ya kansa. Chemotherapia labda ndiyo mtu wengi wanafikiria kwanza. Ilitumika mara ya kwanza katika miaka ya 1940 pale madaktari walipotumia dume la nitrojeni (derivative of nitrogen mustard) kutibu lymphoma.

Tangu wakati huo, dawa mia kadhaa zimeundwa kama chemotherapia, zikiwa zimetengenezwa kushambulia seli za kansa. Ni vigumu kufanya jumla kuhusu chemotherapia kwa sababu kuna dawa nyingi tofauti zilizoundwa kutibu aina tofauti za kansa na kwa sababu zina athari mbaya tofauti.

Kutokana na ukweli kwamba zinashambulia seli zinazojidondosha kwa kasi, dawa nyingi za aina hii hupelekea mtu kupoteza nywele kwa kuwa seli za nywele ni aina inayojidondosha kwa kasi. Kutapika, kutapika kwa mkongo, na mabadiliko ya hesabu za damu (hesabu za seli nyepesi chini) ni athari nyingine za kawaida.

Kama kansa imeenea kutoka eneo lililokuwa mwanzo, kuna uwezekano mkubwa itahitaji zaidi ya aina moja ya dawa ili kufikia ukimya wa dalili (remission).

Hata kama kansa haijaenea, madaktari wa upasuaji mara nyingi watapendekeza kufanya chemotherapia kabla ya upasuaji ili kupunguza uvimbe na kufanya uondoaji wa upasuaji kuwa rahisi.

Wakati chemotherapia inasikika kutisha, kweli hufanya kazi vizuri kwa aina fulani za kansa, kama vile kansa za damu (kama leukaemia), lymphoma, na kansa ya matiti.

Sasa hivi, madaktari wa kansa huchunguza seli za kansa zilizochukuliwa kwa biopsi kwa alama za kijeni. Kama daktari wa familia, ninaona ripoti hizi lakini, kwa kuwa mimi si mtaalamu wa fani hii, zinanivuruga kidogo. Jambo muhimu kukumbuka ni kwamba alama hizi husaidia kutabiri ni dawa gani bora kutumia kwa aina maalum ya kansa.

Upasuaji

Kwa miaka mingi, upasuaji ulikuwa nguzo ya matibabu ya kansa. Kansa ambazo hazijaenea zinaweza kuondolewa kabisa, na kumruhusu mtu kuendelea bila matibabu zaidi.

Mara nyingi, wakati kansa ya mtu inagunduliwa, ni kuchelewa kuizuia kabisa. Upasuaji bado unaweza kuwa na msaada. Kwa jambo moja, unatoa sampuli ya kansa kwa ajili ya vipimo kusaidia kutambua matibabu bora. Zaidi ya hapo, hata kama kansa imeenea, kuna nyakati ambapo uvimbe unahitaji kuondolewa, kwa sababu tu waingilia ndani ya viungo vinavyoweka shinikizo.

Nimesikia baadhi ya watu wakidai kuwa ni hatari kwa kansa kufichuliwa kwa oksijeni. Wanaamini kuwa seli za kansa zinaenea kwa kasi zaidi baada ya tishu kufunguliwa na kufichuliwa katika hewa wakati wa upasuaji. Hakuna ushahidi uliowekwa kuunga mkono wazo hili. Watu wengi wanaonekana kuwa wagonjwa zaidi baada ya upasuaji wa uchunguzi wakati kansa yao inatambuliwa. Lakini suala si kweli hewa kuingia kwenye seli za kansa, bali kansa ilikuwa kwa hakika imekuwa ikianza kuonyesha dalili kali, na upasuaji ulileta mambo wazi. Pia, upasuaji wowote utakuwa mzigo kwa mwili wa mtu, jambo litakaloongeza tu kupoteza nguvu na uhai wa mtu aliyeshindwa—uwezo wao wa kukabiliana na ugonjwa unaochosha.

Mara nyingi, uvimbe ukiondolewa, viu ta za limfu zenye karibu zitachukuliwa sampuli kuona kama zina seli za kansa. Uwepo au kutokuwepo kwa seli hizi husaidia katika “kustaiaji” (kama “sikio la 3” au “sikio la 4”) na itatoa mwanga kwa matibabu zaidi ili kuzuia nafasi ya kurudi kwa kansa.

Immunotherapia

Mojawapo ya matibabu mapya ya kansa huitwa immunotherapia. Hizi ni dawa zinazochochea mfumo wa kinga wa mgonjwa ili kuondoa seli za kansa mwilini mwao.

Hii inasikika nzuri na mtu angeweza kufikiria kuwa athari zake za pembeni zinapaswa kuwa ndogo. Kwa bahati mbaya, si mara zote zinakwenda kama ilivyopangwa. Baadhi ya kansa hazitoki kwa matibabu ya aina hizi. Na kuhusu athari za pembeni, dawa hizi zinaweza kusababisha magonjwa ya kinga mwilini (autoimmune diseases). Wakati dawa inapotolewa ambayo inafanya mfumo wa kinga kuwa na shughuli nyingi (au kupitiliza), wakati mwingine huanza kushambulia viungo vya mgonjwa mwenyewe. Ingawa baadhi ya athari hizi za pembeni huwa bora baada ya kuacha matibabu, si zote zinaondoka.

Kama mfano, nilikuwa na mgonjwa aliyechukuliwa immunotherapia kwa melanoma ambayo ilikuwa imeenea hadi kwa vifundo vya limfu. Alipona kutoka kwa kansa, lakini immunotherapia iliharibu tezi za mate kwa kiasi kwamba ana matatizo ya kudumu ya kavu ya kinywa. Hivi sasa, inaonekana hawezi kupata tena unyevu huo katika kinywa chake.

Matibabu ya Baadaye

Huenda kutakuwa na matibabu zaidi kwa siku zijazo, zikilenga aina maalum za kansa. Kitu ambacho kwa sasa kinachunguzwa ni chanjo zitakazolenga aina maalum za kansa. Hivi sasa hakuna kati yao zinapatikana isipokuwa katika majaribio ya kliniki.

Kuchagua Kwa Busara

Onkolojisti (mataalamu wa kansa) hawajui siku za usoni. Wanaongea kwa istilahi za asilimia. Mchakato mmoja una nafasi ya asilimia 86 ya kufikia ukimya wa dalili kwa miaka miwili, mwingine ni asilimia 56 tu. Hali ile ile ni kweli kwa athari za pembeni. Wakati daktari anaweza kukuambia kuwa asilimia 26 ya wagonjwa wanahisi kichefuchefu kwa matibabu, hilo halikuambii kama utakuwa miongoni mwa asilimia 26 hiyo na kama kichefuchefu hicho kitatibika kwa dawa za kupunguza kichefuchefu.

Kutokana na uamuzi wa njia gani ya matibabu kuchagua, hautapati kifungu cha Biblia kinachoonyesha upande mmoja au mwingine. Kuwa na onkologisti mzuri atakayeeleza mambo kwa uwazi—pamoja na nafasi ya mafanikio na hatari za athari za pembeni—ni muhimu. Kuna nyakati ambapo unaweza kuhitaji kubadilisha daktari wa kansa, kwa sababu tu yule uliyenayo hatochukua muda unaohitaji ili ujihisi uko katika hali ya kuaminika na matibabu yako.

Kama mmoja kati yenu anakosa busara, na aombe kwa Mungu, ambaye hutoa kwa wote kwa wingi, wala hamtakisi; naye atampa –Yakobo 1:5. Tunahitaji busara katika nyanja nyingi za maisha yetu, lakini bila shaka kuchagua jinsi ya kuendesha maamuzi ya matibabu ni mojawapo ya nyanja hizo. Ni jambo zuri kwamba Mungu ameahidi kutupa busara tunayohitaji—ikiwa tu tunaomba.

Mwomba waumini—sala binafsi pamoja na ile ya jamii ya kanisa lako—ni muhimu sana. Maombi yanaweza kuwa kwa ajili ya uponyaji. Pia yanaweza kuwa kwa ajili ya watoa huduma za afya wanaomtendea mtu kimawazo ya Kikristo, na kwa ajili ya busara katika kuchagua matibabu bora.

Mara nyingine Mungu anaponya kupitia kwa madaktari na dawa. Wakati mwingine, Huponya licha yao. Wakati mwingine Huamua kwamba ni wakati wetu kurudi nyumbani kwa Yeye, na hivyo kutupatia mwili mpya usio mgonjwa na usiovunjika.

Bariki, Ee BWANA, roho yangu, wala usisahau yote faida zake: Yeye anayekusamehe hata dhambi zako zote; Yeye anayaponya magonjwa yako yote –Zaburi 103:2-3. Kwa teknolojia yote ya matibabu iliyo mbele yetu, ni rahisi kusahau kwamba uponyaji unatoka kwa Mungu. Chemotherapia yote ya dunia haitakuwa na maana ikiwa Mungu hatatenda tendo la uponyaji. Wakati huo huo, mara nyingi Mungu hutenda kwa njia za muujiza kuponya licha ya utabiri mbaya uliotolewa na wataalamu wa matibabu au watu wengine wenye nia njema.

Mara nyingi bora kwa mgonjwa ni kuchagua (kulingana na hukumu yao bora) mkondo bora wa matibabu (kulingana na kiwango cha mafanikio na athari za pembeni) na kisha kuona jinsi mambo yatakavyoenda. Ikiwa athari za pembeni ni kali sana au matibabu hayaonekani kufanya kazi, daima kuna nafasi ya kubadilisha.

Kwa mwisho, pale uponyaji unapokuja, bila kujali jinsi ulivyojengwa, ni Mungu ndiye anayetoa uponyaji huo. Tusisahau hilo kamwe.

Kansa Hutumia Nguvu

Kuhusiana na mtu mwenye kansa si tofauti kubwa sana na kuhusiana na mtu mwenye ugonjwa mwingine sugu. Hata hivyo kuna tofauti.

Kuwa na kansa na kupokea matibabu ya kansa kunachukua nguvu nyingi kutoka kwa mtu. Wakati ni muhimu kutoeza mtu mwenye kansa, ni muhimu pia kukumbuka kwamba hawana akiba ya nguvu isiyo na kikomo. Ziara ya dakika kumi au kumi na tano inaweza kuwa ni yote wanaweza kuvumilia. Ni bora kuwaacha wao waamua urefu wa ziara wanayo kuwa nayo kwa nguvu zao.

Tikisika Kutoa Ushauri

“Binamu” wako anaweza kuwa amepitia kansa na akapona baada ya kutumia virutubisho fulani au kutembelea kliniki fulani. Kushiriki habari hiyo na mtu anayeishi na kansa ni kipande kingine tu cha habari kwao kuchanganua miongoni mwa “elfu” nyingine walizopokea. Inaonekana mtu mwenye kansa mara nyingi anapalaumiwa kwa ushauri na mapendekezo kutoka kwa marafiki na familia wenye nia njema.

Ni vigumu kubaini nini cha kufanya wakati mtu tayari hana nguvu nyingi. Wakati mwingine, wagonjwa wa kansa huomba tu kwamba Mungu ambariki chaguo zao na kisha wauache matokeo mikononi Mwake.

Kama mgonjwa wa kansa akikuomba maoni yako, unaweza kuyatoa, lakini ikiwa hapofuati, labda ni bora kujizuia kutaka kutoa ushauri usioulizwa.

Sikiliza

Hakuna hali ambapo kusikiliza hakutakuwa na faida. Kupitia kusikiliza tunamruhusu mwingine kuachilia hofu na hasira zao. Kusikiliza kunaweza kumsaidia mtu kuweka mawazo yao kwa maneno. Zaidi ya hayo, tunaweza kusikia njia ambazo tunaweza kusaidia.

Labda ni mtu anayekuambia hadithi ndefu jinsi daktari wao alivyokosa kansa yao. Au labda ni wanakulia kuhusu hofu zao zinazohusiana na kansa yao au matibabu yao.

Tafakari

…Sala yenye nguvu ya mwaminifu ina faida tele –Yakobo 5:16. Aya hii inakuja katikati ya Yakobo anayezungumzia kupaka mafuta kwa mafuta, kukiri dhambi, na uponyaji wa kimwili.

Tunaweza bila shaka kuomba, na kuomba pamoja na, mtu anayeshughulika na kansa. Kusikiliza kunatusaidia kujua ni jinsi gani tunapaswa kuwaombea. Kunatuambia ni mapambano yao maalum siku fulani na jinsi tunavyoweza kuwaweka juu ya kiti cha enzi kwa sala zetu.

Sehemu katika Yakobo inaonyesha wazi kuwa uponyaji haukatoki kwa mafuta yaliyomwagwa juu ya mtu, bali kutoka kwa kazi ya Mungu maishani mwao. Sala, imani, na tendo la utii ni muhimu zaidi kuliko mafuta ya kupaka, ingawa zote zinaonyesha utegemezi kwa Mungu ambaye ni mwaminifu daima.

Fanya Kazi Ndogo za Nyumbani

Ikiwa ndugu au dada wako wako uchi, na hawana chakula cha kila siku, na mmoja wenu akawaambia, Nenda kwa amani, msimizeni na msongwe; na hamwatolei vitu vya mwili; je, itawafaidishaje? –Yakobo 2:15-16.

Ikiwa si vya kutosha kumuombea mtu anayeishi na ugonjwa mzito, hakika si vya kutosha kumwambia, “Mungu akubariki.”

Kubaini mambo ambayo mtu mwenye kansa anahitaji msaada nayo inaweza kuwa si rahisi, lakini mara nyingi hata kazi ndogo ni ngumu kwao. Inaweza kuwa wanahitaji usafiri kwenda miadi ya chemotherapia. Labda wanahitaji msaada kuandaa chakula, kwa malezi ya watoto, au kwa kusafisha nyumba yao. Kusaidia kwa njia zozote tunazoweza kunafanya tofauti kubwa kwa wale wanaokabiliana na uchovu na msongo wa kansa.

Zaidi ya hayo, jambo muhimu ni kwamba tuchukue juhudi kuonyesha upendo wetu kwa wale walioko ndani ya mwili wa kanisa letu wanaoteseka. Paulo aliwaambia Wakorintho kwamba …wakati mmoja anateseka, wanashiriki wote pamoja naye… –1 Wakorintho 12:26. Kila wakati kuna hitaji, sehemu nyingine ya kanisa la mahali ina wajibu na inapaswa kuwa na tamaa kubwa ya kusaidia kwa njia yoyote wanayoweza.

Kua Tayari Kuhifadhi Umbali Wako

Chemotherapia inaweza kusababisha mfumo wa kinga wa mgonjwa wa kansa kuwa dhaifu sana. Hesabu ya kawaida ya seli nyeupe ni kati ya 4,000 na 10,000, lakini wakati wa matibabu ya kansa nimeona hesabu za seli nyeupe za mgonjwa zipungua hadi 200. Katika hali hii, kama watapata aina yoyote ya maambukizi, hawataweza kupambana na maambukizi hayo na watamalizika hospitalini.

Ni muhimu kuelewa kwamba mtu katika hali hii anayechagua kuzuia kukaribia si lazima anajaribu kuepuka ushirika. Badala yake, wanajaribu kuepuka kujazwa hospitalini kwa kile madaktari wa kansa wanaita “homa ya neutropenia” (ugonjwa wenye homa na hesabu ya chini sana ya seli nyeupe).

Katika aina hizi za hali, simu za simu au hata ujumbe wa maandishi hufanya mengi kuwahisisha ndugu au dada kwamba hawako peke yao, hata wanapoweza kukaribia kimwili watu wengine.

Hitimisho

Ningependa niweze kutoa orodha kamili ya kila aina ya kansa iliyopo na matibabu bora kwa kila moja. Hilo lingekuwa nje ya uwezo wangu na zaidi ya hayo, lingeisha ndani ya miezi sita.

Ni ninachoweza kusema ni kwamba sala ni muhimu. Sala kwa ajili ya uongozi wa Roho Mtakatifu (tazama Yoh 16:13), kwa nguvu za kila siku, kwa uponyaji, na kwa kutimizwa kwa mapenzi ya Mungu. Zaidi ya yote, tunahitaji kuomba kwamba Mungu atukamatishe katika na kupitia sisi. (Tazama 1 Petro 4:11) Kumekuwa na watu wengi walioweza kuongea na wauguzi na madaktari wao kuhusu Bwana wao, hata walipokuwa wakikabiliana na athari za pembeni na dalili za kansa.

Ni rahisi kusoma maagizo yote kuhusu kuacha kuwa na wasiwasi yanayopatikana katika Maandiko na kufikiri kwamba kutakuwa rahisi kuwarejesha mawazo yetu kwake (tazama 1 Petro 5:7). Hata hivyo, ni ngumu zaidi kutekeleza. Tunaweza kujihisi siku moja kwamba tumeushinda hofu na kuamka asubuhi iliyofuata tukiwa na wasiwasi mwingi kama tulivyokuwa hapo awali.

Ni katika hili ambapo tunahitaji jamii ya kanisa kwa uamuzi. Hatuwezi kuwa peke yetu, lakini tutahisi peke ikiwa hatuna ndugu na dada karibu nasi ambao hutusaidia kadri wanavyoweza na ambao hutuombea katika mabonde yetu na kufurahi nasi wakati wa ushindi wetu.

Ni tu kisha, tunaweza kufika mahali ambapo Mtume Paulo alifika alipotamka, Kwangu kuishi ni Kristo, na kufa ni faida –Wafilipi 1:21. Bila shaka, alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu adhabu ya kifo inayoweza kutokea, lakini kukubali kwake mapenzi ya Mungu kulikuwa kamili. Ninaomba pia sisi tufikie mahali hapo, hata tunapokabiliana na kitu kigumu kama kansa.

That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling… –Ephesians 1:17-18.

We all have things we pursue in many aspects of our life. We all need to spend time fulfilling our responsibilities at work and at home. As Anabaptist people, we are known to possess a solid work ethic; but that is not all there is to living the Christian life. We may fellowship with likeminded believers from our church or community, but does our Christian life consist of anything more? Does practically living out our Christian life just mean being a member of our church and having personal devotions every day? Are we free to spend most of our day pursuing things that bring worldly gain? Perhaps we think that we need to spend some time as a volunteer or as a missionary in order to have more value in the Kingdom of Heaven.

What is purpose? Do you have purpose? Everyone has things they pursue, whether it is preparing themselves for a certain sport, pursuing a career, or devoting time to a certain hobby. An athlete spends many hours preparing himself for the goal he has set. An individual studying to become a doctor sacrifices many hours of his time with the goal of becoming a physician. What are the things you are pursuing, and do you have a specific goal in mind? More importantly, let’s examine whether the time we are investing in our pursuits now will bring an eternal return.

God has given each of us a responsibility

In Luke 19 is the parable of the nobleman giving his servants talents to invest. Consider the charge he gave his servants in verse 13. He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return. And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come –Luke 19:12-13.

This parable applies to each one of us. Each of us has different responsibilities, from filling our responsibilities at home, to administrative roles in a place of business. While we do not all own equal responsibilities, we have all been given “talents” to use. We all have a place to fill. We should be making the best of the resources we have been given to invest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

Back to my question, “Does living our Christian life just mean being a member of our church and having personal devotions once a day?” If the Lord has given each of us resources to invest, then we need to consider what we are doing with the time we are given every day. Often, we can budget plenty of time pursuing materialistic things such as hunting, sports, vehicles, etc. While all these things can be useful and healthy, do the things we are pursuing have eternal gain? We don’t seem to be afraid to devote hours of our time on our latest project, however it seems we have a hard time finding a place in our schedule for God’s work.

Personal responsibility

It is easy to have the mindset that, unless we are sacrificing our time in some voluntary capacity in a mission-oriented place, then there is not a lot more than can be done for the Kingdom of Heaven. Is that the reality though? Like the servants in the parable, we have each been given resources that we need to “occupy till the Lord returns”. The Lord has placed each of us in a unique place to serve in His kingdom, whether it is at home, on the job, or on the mission field. We have opportunities around us to exercise those gifts and show the love of Christ. The consideration should be whether I am actually seeing those opportunities or missing them because I am not looking for them. The more time we prioritize serving His Kingdom, the more we will see the needs around us. Remember, there are people around us every day that we can influence for God.

Recognizing our opportunities

Some time ago, I had a coworker come to my office and ask me a simple technical question. I was able to answer the question and work resumed as normal. But I had to wonder why he left the shop and came to me. He was within talking distance of multiple other individuals that would have been able to answer his question. Looking back, I realized that I had an opportunity to provide a listening ear and some caring words for this individual. He was facing some serious personal and relational challenges in life, and he needed someone who cared for him. I realized that there was probably a deeper reason he went out of his way to find an answer to his question. Was I the only one there that could have listened and shared with him? Certainly not. It was an opportunity for me. I could have chosen to be annoyed at him because he was taking up my time for something that someone else could have helped him with. But the question is—did I have the humility to recognize that it was an opportunity for me to reach out to him?

Where do I start?

We all have opportunities around us to exercise our talents. Jesus said: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men –Matthew 5:13. Salt always affects its environment no matter what it is used for. If we are compared to salt, then we should be affecting the environment around us all the time. Our Christian life then becomes more than simply going to church or spending some personal time praying and reading the Bible.

Start by asking God to help you see areas where you can serve others in everyday life. You have an opportunity to impact the lives of those around you. It might be your family, coworkers, customers, or people you meet while away from home. The point is, you have the opportunity around you to offer someone help, to encourage them, or to give them a hand. Are you making the best of those opportunities?

Another thing you should do is evaluate your personal life and the time you spend doing other activities. Are there things you are doing which take up your time and that have no benefit in the Kingdom of God? Maybe God has given you a gift that you are hiding instead of using to invest in His Kingdom. Do you spend time praying and seeking God’s will for your life? Do you spend time studying the Word of God? When our personal time with God becomes a higher priority for us, then our time spent pursuing God’s Kingdom will also become a higher priority. Is there sin hindering you from living out your Christian life? Confess it. Repent of it. Then… Go, and sin no more!

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God –Hebrews 12:1-2.

In the beginning of the article, I asked what you are pursuing. Does your life show that fulfilling God’s will is your highest priority, or is there something else that takes that spot? Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost –Romans 15:13. There are people around us that do not have the hope of a better, future life to strive for that we do. It is up to us to share that with others. Ask God for His Spirit to guide you and show you your opportunities. You cannot sit back and wait for the opportunities to come to you; you need to go find them. Go light your world!

Dass der Gott unsres Herrn Jesus Christus, der Vater der Herrlichkeit, euch gebe den Geist der Weisheit und Offenbarung zur Erkenntnis seiner selbst; erleuchte die Augen eures Herzens, damit ihr wisst, was die Hoffnung seiner Berufung ist… –Epheser 1,17-18.

Wir alle verfolgen im Leben verschiedene Dinge. Wir müssen Zeit aufwenden, um unsere Pflichten bei der Arbeit und zu Hause zu erfüllen. Als anabaptistische Gemeinschaft sind wir dafür bekannt, eine solide Arbeitsmoral zu besitzen; aber das ist nicht alles, was das christliche Leben ausmacht. Wir pflegen Gemeinschaft mit gleichgesinnten Gläubigen aus unserer Kirche oder Gemeinde — doch besteht unser christliches Leben darin noch aus mehr? Bedeutet praktisches Christsein lediglich, Mitglied unserer Kirche zu sein und täglich persönliche Andachten zu halten? Dürfen wir den Großteil unseres Tages damit verbringen, weltlichen Gewinn zu verfolgen? Vielleicht denken wir, wir müssten Zeit als Freiwillige oder als Missionare einsetzen, um mehr Wert im Reich des Himmels zu haben.

Was ist Zielsetzung bzw. Berufung? Hast du eine Berufung? Jeder verfolgt etwas, sei es die Vorbereitung für eine bestimmte Sportart, die Verfolgung einer Berufs­laufbahn oder die Hingabe von Zeit für ein bestimmtes Hobby. Ein Athlet verbringt viele Stunden mit der Vorbereitung auf das gesetzte Ziel. Eine Person, die Medizin studiert, opfert viele Stunden mit dem Ziel, Arzt zu werden. Was sind die Dinge, die du verfolgst, und hast du ein konkretes Ziel vor Augen? Noch wichtiger: Lassen sich die Zeiten, die wir jetzt in unsere Vorhaben investieren, in Ewigkeit auszahlen?

Gott hat jedem von uns eine Verantwortung gegeben

In Lukas 19 steht das Gleichnis von dem Edelmann, der seinen Knechten Talente zum Verwalten gab. Bedenke den Auftrag, den er seinen Knechten in Vers 13 gab. Er sprach daher: Ein gewisser Edelmann zog in ein fernes Land, um sich ein Königtum zu empfangen und wiederzukommen. Und er rief seine zehn Knechte und gab ihnen zehn Pfund und sprach zu ihnen: Geschäftet, bis ich komme –Lukas 19,12-13.

Dieses Gleichnis gilt für jeden von uns. Jeder von uns hat unterschiedliche Verantwortungen, sei es das Erfüllen von Pflichten zu Hause oder Verwaltungsaufgaben in einem Betrieb. Zwar sind unsere Verantwortungen nicht bei allen gleich groß, doch uns allen sind „Talente“ zum Gebrauch gegeben worden. Wir alle haben einen Platz auszufüllen. Wir sollten das Beste aus den Mitteln machen, die uns gegeben sind, und in das Reich des Himmels investieren.

Zurück zu meiner Frage: „Bedeutet christlich leben bloß, Mitglied unserer Kirche zu sein und einmal täglich persönliche Andachten zu halten?“ Wenn der Herr jedem von uns Ressourcen gegeben hat, die zu investieren sind, dann müssen wir überlegen, was wir mit der Zeit tun, die uns jeden Tag gegeben ist. Oft können wir viel Zeit für materialistische Dinge einplanen wie Jagen, Sport, Fahrzeuge usw. Zwar können all diese Dinge nützlich und gesund sein, aber haben die Dinge, die wir verfolgen, ewigen Gewinn? Wir scheinen nicht davor zurückzuschrecken, Stunden in unser neuestes Projekt zu investieren; dennoch fällt es uns schwer, einen Platz in unserem Zeitplan für das Werk Gottes zu finden.

Persönliche Verantwortung

Es ist leicht, die Einstellung zu haben, dass außer dem Opfer unserer Zeit in einer freiwilligen missionarischen Tätigkeit nicht viel mehr für das Reich des Himmels getan werden könne. Ist das aber die Realität? Wie die Knechte im Gleichnis sind uns allen Aufgaben und Mittel gegeben worden, die wir „verwalten sollen, bis der Herr wiederkommt“. Der Herr hat jeden von uns an einen einzigartigen Ort gestellt, um in seinem Reich zu dienen – sei es zu Hause, am Arbeitsplatz oder auf dem Missionsfeld. Um uns herum gibt es Möglichkeiten, diese Gaben einzusetzen und die Liebe Christi zu zeigen. Die Frage ist, ob ich diese Gelegenheiten tatsächlich sehe oder sie verpasse, weil ich nicht nach ihnen suche. Je mehr Zeit wir dem Dienen in seinem Reich einräumen, desto mehr werden wir die Bedürfnisse um uns herum wahrnehmen. Denke daran: Jeden Tag gibt es Menschen um uns, die wir für Gott beeinflussen können.

Unsere Gelegenheiten erkennen

Vor einiger Zeit kam ein Kollege in mein Büro und stellte mir eine einfache technische Frage. Ich konnte die Frage beantworten und die Arbeit ging normal weiter. Dennoch fragte ich mich, warum er den Laden verließ und zu mir kam. Er stand in sprechbarer Entfernung zu mehreren anderen Personen, die ihm hätten antworten können. Rückblickend erkannte ich, dass ich die Gelegenheit gehabt hatte, ihm ein offenes Ohr und ein paar fürsorgliche Worte zu schenken. Er stand vor ernsthaften persönlichen und beziehungsbezogenen Herausforderungen im Leben und brauchte jemanden, dem er wichtig war. Ich erkannte, dass es wohl einen tieferen Grund gab, warum er sich extra auf den Weg gemacht hatte, um eine Antwort zu finden. War ich der Einzige dort, der hätte zuhören und mit ihm teilen können? Sicherlich nicht. Es war eine Gelegenheit für mich. Ich hätte mich über ihn ärgern können, weil er meine Zeit für etwas beanspruchte, wobei ihm auch jemand anders hätte helfen können. Aber die Frage ist: Hatte ich die Demut, zu erkennen, dass es eine Gelegenheit für mich war, auf ihn zuzugehen?

Womit fange ich an?

Wir alle haben Gelegenheiten um uns herum, unsere Gaben einzusetzen. Jesus sagte: Ihr seid das Salz der Erde; wenn aber das Salz seinen Geschmack verliert, womit soll man salzen? Zu nichts mehr taugt es denn, dass man es wegwerfe und es von den Leuten zertreten werde –Matthäus 5,13. Salz beeinflusst stets seine Umgebung, egal wozu es gebraucht wird. Wenn wir mit Salz verglichen werden, dann sollten wir die Umgebung um uns herum beständig beeinflussen. Unser christliches Leben wird damit mehr als nur Kirchgang oder etwas persönliche Zeit im Gebet und Bibellesen.

Fange damit an, Gott zu bitten, dir Bereiche zu zeigen, in denen du anderen im Alltag dienen kannst. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Leben um dich herum zu beeinflussen. Es kann deine Familie sein, Mitarbeiter, Kunden oder Menschen, denen du unterwegs begegnest. Der Punkt ist: Du hast Möglichkeiten in deiner Nähe, jemandem Hilfe anzubieten, ihn zu ermutigen oder ihm beizustehen. Nutzst du diese Gelegenheiten bestmöglich?

Eine weitere Sache, die du tun solltest, ist, dein persönliches Leben und die Zeit, die du mit anderen Aktivitäten verbringst, zu prüfen. Gibt es Dinge, die deine Zeit beanspruchen und die kein Nutzen im Reich Gottes haben? Vielleicht hat Gott dir eine Gabe gegeben, die du verbirgst, anstatt sie zu gebrauchen, um in sein Reich zu investieren. Verbringst du Zeit im Beten und im Suchen von Gottes Willen für dein Leben? Verbringst du Zeit mit dem Studium des Wortes Gottes? Wenn unsere persönliche Zeit mit Gott für uns eine höhere Priorität wird, dann wird auch die Zeit, die wir dem Streben nach Gottes Reich widmen, eine höhere Priorität erhalten. Steht eine Sünde zwischen dir und dem Leben als Christ? Bekenne sie. Bereue sie. Dann… Gehe hin und sündige nicht mehr!

Darum wir auch, weil wir eine so große Wolke von Zeugen um uns haben, ablegen alles Gewicht und die Sünde, die uns so leicht umstrickt, und laufen mit Geduld in dem vorgestellten Wettlauf, und blicken auf Jesus, den Anfänger und Vollender des Glaubens; welcher, anstatt die Schande zu achten, das Kreuz erduldet hat um der vor ihm liegenden Freude willen und ist gesetzt zur Rechten des Thrones Gottes –Hebräer 12,1-2.

Zu Beginn des Artikels fragte ich, was du verfolgst. Zeigt dein Leben, dass es die Erfüllung von Gottes Willen ist, die deine höchste Priorität ist, oder nimmt etwas anderes diesen Platz ein? Der Gott der Hoffnung aber erfülle euch mit aller Freude und Frieden im Glauben, damit ihr immer reicher werdet an Hoffnung durch die Kraft des Heiligen Geistes –Römer 15,13. Es gibt Menschen um uns, die nicht die Hoffnung auf ein besseres zukünftiges Leben haben, wie wir sie haben. Es liegt an uns, das mit anderen zu teilen. Bitte Gott um seinen Geist, der dich führt und dir deine Gelegenheiten zeigt. Du kannst dich nicht zurücklehnen und darauf warten, dass die Gelegenheiten zu dir kommen; du musst sie suchen. Geh hinaus und erhelle deine Welt!

Sigmund Freud, the “father of psychology” and an enemy of the Christian faith, spent much time reflecting on the “problem” of how to overcome the sense of guilt, which he believed to be the negative by-product of religious teaching. He commented that “only through the solidarity of all the participants (of a group) could the sense of guilt be assuaged.”

Being a member of a group with a common focus or goal has the ability to radically change, not only man’s outlook and views, but also his concept of right and wrong, good and evil, etc. It can indeed rid the soul of its normal God-given sense of guilt as the standards of right and wrong are modified. Some parents have discovered this fact when their young people joined a youth group. Some who previously respected their parents’, the church’s, and God’s authority, no longer held the same convictions. If they joined a group whose focus was to have fun and they believed that the “established” rules, facts, and truth were what stood in the way of fulfilling their carnal desires, then the establishment and their rules became the enemy of the group. Right and wrong are determined by the consensus of the group in respect to its goals. If the goal is pleasure, “It isn’t right for (any authority or any rule) to interfere.”

“The child takes on the characteristic behavior of the group in which he is placed … he reflects the behavior patterns which are set by the … leader of the group” (Kurt Lewin, in A Sociology of Education).

Although it seems strange, “it is usually easier to change individuals formed into a group than to change any one of them separately”, according to Kurt Lewin. An individual will naturally resist change to his or her personal beliefs. However, one who is already a member of a group with a common goal (which all groups have), will automatically have that resistance broken down, as far as attitudes of the group are concerned. Example: I am part of this group, so the outlook and opinions of the group are my outlook and opinions. Too often, not one individual of the group will thoroughly examine the group’s beliefs but will take them for granted because they are a part of the group to which he or she belongs.

“One of the most fascinating aspects of group therapy is that everyone is born again, born together in the group”. (Irvin D. Yalom). This can easily be observed among all ages who are part of a group by virtue of common interests.

Adolf Hitler made very effective use of group dynamics with his Hitler Youth groups. Not only was he able to give them a sense of belonging and a cause to support, but he was able to effectively change the moral compass of the youth of his day.

The Bible also records very effective group dynamics and how quickly they can influence people without evidence. In Acts 14:1, we see the group ready to offer sacrifices to Paul as a god, and in the next verse they stoned him. Acts 19 tells of a group yelling “Great is Diana of the Ephesians” for hours. Verse 32 says that most of the people didn’t even know what the fuss was about, but they would have killed for whatever it was. In these examples, possibly not even one individual really stopped to seriously consider what was morally right or wrong. They were taking up the cause of the group. It gave a sense of “rightness” and belonging, just to be a contributing supporter of the cause. But stop and think—the cause, the action, and the consequences should always be carefully considered.

These people were not taking individual responsibility to determine what is morally right and wrong. Too often people don’t, rather they only function as a group. But the Bible tells us that the time will come when we will all be personally held accountable for what we have done in this life. At that time, what the group believed or did will make no difference. When we (each one of us) will stand one day (at the end of time) before God’s judgement throne, we will be judged according to …the righteous judgment of God; Who will render to every man according to his deeds –Romans 2:5-6.

As we read in the biblical books of the Kings and the Chronicles, Israel, as a nation, functioned with strong group dynamics. When a good king came to power, the nation in general turned to the Lord. When an evil king came to power, the nation in general turned to idol worship. There were a few exceptions—a few people who thought for themselves—whose allegiance to God was greater than their allegiance to the king or nation.

The Christian church itself is a group, influencing and changing the perspectives and morality of individuals for the right or the wrong. Dependent on the convictions of the group and its leaders, the church can be an influence of godly morality, or it can explain away the Bible’s concepts of good and evil.

There should be a major difference between the Christian church and all other groups regarding how their group dynamics work. The Christian church is a group for the express purpose of turning people’s allegiance and faith to Jesus Christ as revealed in His Word, rather than to the group itself. A church whose goal is to gain converts to itself has failed in its mission as detailed in God’s Word. A church that is successful in turning people from all other allegiances to Jesus Christ is a successful church. Allegiance to Jesus includes obedience to His Word which requires obedience to all authorities, including the church. But the Christian’s obedience to the church is secondary and a result of his obedience to Jesus, not the other way around. If a church is successful in turning its members’ faith and focus to Jesus as revealed in His Word, these members will then be unwilling to allow the church to accept unscriptural modern doctrines, and the church will remain sound in …the faith which was once delivered unto the saints –Jude 1:3.

May each one of us, both collectively and individually, focus our faith on Jesus Christ.

西格蒙德·弗洛伊德，这位“心理学之父”且为基督信仰的敌人，花了大量时间思考如何克服内疚感的“问题”，他认为这是宗教教导的负面副产物。他评论说“只有通过所有参与者（群体）的团结，内疚感才能被缓和”。

成为一个具有共同焦点或目标的群体成员，不仅能够彻底改变人的观点和看法，也能改变他对是非、善恶等的概念。的确，当正确与错误的标准被修改时，它可以清除灵魂那来自神的正常内疚感。有些父母在他们的年轻人加入青年团体后便发现了这一事实。有些原本尊重父母、教会和上帝权柄的人，不再持有相同的信念。如果他们加入的团体以娱乐为中心，而他们又认为“既定”的规则、事实与真理阻碍了满足他们肉体的欲望，那么既定体制和它们的规则就成了群体的敌人。对与错由群体就其目标达成的共识来决定。如果目标是享乐，“（任何权威或任何规则）干涉是不对的”。

“孩子会采取他所处群体的特征性行为……他反映出由该群体的……领袖所设定的行为模式”（库尔特·勒温，摘自《教育社会学》）。

尽管看起来奇怪，库尔特·勒温指出，“通常把个体组织成群体后，比单独改变任何一个人要容易得多”。个人自然会抵抗对其个人信念的改变。然而，已经成为具有共同目标的群体成员（所有群体都有共同目标）的人，在群体态度方面的抵抗会自动被瓦解。例子：我是这个群体的一员，所以群体的观点和意见就是我的观点和意见。太常见的情况是，群体中没有哪一个个人会彻底审视群体的信念，而是理所当然地接受它们，因为他们属于该群体。

“团体治疗最引人注目的方面之一是每个人都在群体中一起重生”（欧文·D·雅隆）。这在所有因共同兴趣而成为群体一部分的各年龄层中都很容易观察到。

阿道夫·希特勒非常有效地利用了群体动力学来经营他的希特勒青年团。他不仅能给他们以归属感和一个支持的事业，还能有效地改变当时青年的道德指针。

圣经也记载了非常有效的群体动力学，以及它们如何在没有证据的情况下迅速影响人们。在使徒行传14:1中，我们看到群体准备向保罗献祭，视他为神；下一节他们又用石头打他。使徒行传19章记载了一个群体连续几个小时高喊“以弗所人的大神大雅典娜（或“大阿耳忒弥斯”）”的情形。第32节说大多数人甚至不知道争吵为何事，但他们会为此杀人。在这些例子中，可能连一个人也没有认真停下来思考什么在道德上是对或错。他们是在为群体的事业而行动。仅仅成为该事业的支持者就带来了一种“正当性”和归属感。但停下来想一想——事业、行动和其后果都应当被仔细考虑。

这些人并没有承担个人责任来决定什么在道德上是对或错。人们常常不这样做，而只是作为群体运作。但圣经告诉我们，时机将到，我们都要为今生所行的一切亲自负责。那时，群体所信或所行将毫无差别。当我们（我们每一个人）有一天（在时间的终结）站在上帝的审判宝座前时，我们要根据……上帝公义的审判；他要照各人行为的报应审判各人——罗马书 2:5-6 被审判。

正如我们在《列王纪》和《历代志》这些圣经书卷中所读，以色列作为一个民族，具有强烈的群体动力学运作。当一位良善的君王执掌时，国家总体上转向耶和华；当一位邪恶的君王执掌时，国家总体上转向偶像崇拜。有少数例外——少数为自己思考的人——他们对上帝的忠诚大于对君王或国家的忠诚。

基督教会自身也是一个群体，会对个人的观点和道德产生正面或负面的影响。取决于群体及其领袖的信念，教会可以成为敬虔道德的影响力，也可以为圣经的善恶观找到借口加以解释或淡化。

关于群体动力学的运作，基督教会与其他所有群体之间应有重大不同。基督教会是一个群体，其明确目的在于将人的效忠和信心转向耶稣基督，如同在他的话语中所启示的，而不是转向群体本身。一个以使人皈依到自己为目标的教会，已在神的话语所详述的使命上失败了。一个成功地使人从一切其他效忠转到耶稣基督的教会，才是真正成功的教会。对耶稣的效忠包括顺服他的话，这要求顺服一切权柄，包括教会。但基督徒对教会的顺服是次要的，是他对耶稣顺服的结果，而不是相反。如果一个教会成功地将其成员的信心和关注转向在他的话语中所启示的耶稣，这些成员就不会允许教会接受不合圣经的现代教义，教会也将保持在……那信仰中仍然坚固不移，正如曾经被交付给圣徒的——犹大书 1:3。

愿我们每一个人，无论作为集体还是个人，都将我们的信心聚焦在耶稣基督身上。
